description.Description: User-provided description for this VMware Engine network.

location.Description: The location where the VMwareEngineNetwork should reside.

state.Description: State of the VMware Engine network.

type.Description: VMware Engine network type. Possible values: ["LEGACY", "STANDARD"]

uid.Description: System-generated unique identifier for the resource.

vpc_networks.Description:
VMware Engine service VPC networks that provide connectivity from a private cloud to customer projects,
the internet, and other Google Cloud services.

network.Description:
The relative resource name of the service VPC network this VMware Engine network is attached to.
For example: projects/123123/global/networks/my-network

type.Description: Type of VPC network (INTRANET, INTERNET, or GOOGLE_CLOUD)
